steps.name: phone-design

Tokens in the phone @theme block of src/app/globals.css (kibo-tint, kibo-bubble, kibo-deep, field, staff-*, online, rounded-tile/sheet, shadow-card/dock, kibo-sheet-in); IBM Plex Sans KR weight 600 added. Presentational components in src/components/phone/ (ui.ts class strings, AppBar, Conversation Bubble/StatusChip, OrderCard/OrderLines/OrderTotal, Suggestions, Dock with TypingSheet and voiceActive, Checkout ConfirmCard/ConfirmBar/PayCard/DoneCard), NOT wired into /assistant yet. Dev-only preview /design/phone (404 in production, checked) with MALO sample data; e2e/qa/design.qa.spec.ts checks 9 frames at 390x844 and 360x800 plus 3 Korean frames, and the dock height <=150px: 0 H, 0 T. steps.name: phone-redesign

Screens: P-start, P1 mic/in-app, P2, P3 (all voice/text/error/choice states), P4 (+typing), P5, P6, P7, PX idle/staff/reconnecting, learned pending/slow/mismatch/confirm, ticket wording. Behavior unchanged (same commands, sources, aria-live). Orchestrator fixes: mic label says what a tap does per state (Tap to talk / Tap to cancel / Tap to end voice, state named first for screen readers; micStop removed), switch shows Voice on/Voice off (on/off keys removed), order number proportional. /demo chrome: phone frame, ActionStrip, ScenarioGuide (cream column, white scenario cards, tinted tags/chips/step numbers, white [Scenarios] pill), DemoEndCard, CompareCard lose dark outlines; kiosk half untouched. Deleted assistant/CartCard, ChoiceButtons, Conversation, VoiceControls; styles.ts trimmed (CHIP, SMALL) and kept only for landing, D1, mic-test (I-165). Tests: assistant.qa closes the sticky field before P4-confirm; checks.ts screenshot waits for kibo-sheet-in (I-163). Before/after: Undo and staff are quiet/compact instead of 2px-outlined pills; the cart total sits in a white shadowed card with a hairline instead of a 2px ink rule; P3 bottom went from mic pill + switch + always-on input (~170px) to one dock with an 88px round mic (~150px closed). lint, build, test 807 passed, test:e2e 19 passed/14 @live skipped, qa:ui 27/27 (0 H). Docs: UI_GUIDE Phone design (dock, P4, P6, /demo surfaces), UX C3, UI_QA, ISSUE I-163..I-165.

steps.name: pairing
steps.summary: A. Pairing code (tests first): POST /api/session returns a 6-digit pairCode for every non-demo session (kiosk only); stored as pairCodes/{code} {sessionId, expiresAt = issue + 1 h, Timestamp for TTL} via SessionStore.reservePairCode (transaction, refuses a live entry, replaces an expired one; up to 5 draws, service reservePairCode) and as the plain digits in sessionSecrets.pairCode (a hash of 6 digits protects nothing; rotation must find the old entry). POST /api/session/pair {code: 6 digits} = same result as a claim ({sessionId, deviceToken, status}; CONFLICT 'Someone else is using this kiosk.', GONE, NOT_FOUND 'That code doesn't match a kiosk. Check the number on the kiosk screen.' for wrong/used/rotated/>1 h codes); single use (claim sets pairCode null, then the entry is deleted); new per-IP limit kind 'pair' 10/min (bad bodies count). reissueClaim rotates the code (result.pairCode + top-level pairCode in the command route; unused new code or replaced old code deleted after the transaction; never kept in recentResults). claimSession/pairSession share claimWith. Kiosk: useKioskSession stores pairCode; pairCode prop threaded KioskScreen -> Attract/Menu/Review/Payment/KioskToolbar; onClaimUrl(claimUrl, pairCode); new src/components/kiosk/PairCode.tsx under the QR on K1 and in the QR sheet ('또는 휴대폰에서 이 주소를 열고 / <host>/app / 이 번호를 넣으세요' + '연결 번호' 72px '123 456', host from the claim URL). PUBLIC_ORIGIN env (publicOrigin uses it when a valid http(s) origin); scripts/deploy.sh reads the project number with gcloud projects describe and sets PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://kibo-<number>.asia-northeast3.run.app (deploy.test.ts updated). /app: pairing card is now the primary (label, numeric one-time-code field 32px digits, strips non-digits so '123 456' works, [Connect] 88px primary), stores kibo.phone.<id> and router.push('/assistant?s=<id>'); [Scan a kiosk] became secondary under 'Or connect with the QR'; appStep1 copy updated; InAppNote (src/components/app/InAppNote.tsx) on /app and /app/scan. B. Scanner: next.config.ts sends camera=(self) only on /app/scan (later header entry wins, per Next docs; scripts/next-config.test.ts + E2E header check). src/lib/phone/kioskQr.ts parseKioskQr(text, origin) (tests first: exact origin, /assistant, SESSION_ID s, #t= token <=128, <=512 chars; foreign vs malformed) + assistantHref rebuilds the link. src/lib/phone/qrDecode.ts: BarcodeDetector(qr_code) else jsqr (npm install jsqr 1.4.0, Apache-2.0) on an in-memory canvas <=640px, ~8 fps. src/app/app/scan (ScanApp): camera hint like the mic hint, getUserMedia(environment) only after the tap, framing square, torch toggle when supported, 'This QR is not a KIBO kiosk.', unavailable state with camera-app advice + paste-link field, camera stopped on success/pagehide/hidden/unmount, vibrate then window.location.assign so /assistant's claim and P1 run. Tests: service/store/route/http/deploy/next-config/kioskQr unit tests; e2e/app-pair.spec.ts (192.0.2.42): headers, kiosk code typed on /app (wrong, short, spaced, single use, kiosk moves to K2), scanner with a generated Y4M QR video as Chromium's fake camera (e2e/qrVideo.ts; foreign refused with no requests sent, kiosk QR claims and is the only POST), no-camera paste path. QA: e2e/qa/scan.qa.spec.ts (192.0.2.43, 5 states x 4 phone sizes), P0-home-pair-error, KX-qr-sheet; all 0 H. Docs: ARCHITECTURE (routes, endpoints, pages, NOT_FOUND, sessionSecrets.pairCode, new pairCodes collection, limits, PUBLIC_ORIGIN), SECURITY (pairing code guarded by rate limit/single use/1 h/TTL, scanner), OPERATIONS (PUBLIC_ORIGIN; TTL command for pairCodes.expiresAt, to be enabled by a person), UX (A2, P0, P0-scan, in-app), UI_GUIDE (Home, Scanner, kiosk pairing line), UI_QA, ISSUE I-167 (long production host wraps, user decides on a custom domain), I-168 (no global cap on distributed guessing), I-169 (P1 hint follows a seen flag, not mic permission). lint, build, test 841 passed/1 skipped, test:e2e 24 passed/14 @live skipped (rewritten evidence restored, I-099), qa:ui 30/30.

steps.name: kiosk-pairing
steps.summary: Laptop as kiosk + real phone. Server (tests first): createSession({demo:true, pairPhone:true}) = a demo session (session.demo true, so demo limits: 3 min voice, 2 Live tokens, 30 chat) that stays idle and unclaimed with a pairCode and no deviceToken; pairPhone without demo is BAD_REQUEST; POST /api/session accepts pairPhone (service/route/live tests). src/lib/kiosk/pairing.ts (tested): phoneLink (waiting/connected/paused from phoneConnectedAt/phoneSeenAt) and orderLine (English status line: step, item count, total; ticket words on ticket machines). src/components/pairing/PairingPanel.tsx (KIBO surface, phone design, English, text >= 18px): KIBO mark + 'Order by talking', status pill ('Waiting for a phone' / 'Phone connected at HH:MM' / 'Connection paused'), while waiting a 320px QR of the claim URL (data-panel-qr; token only inside the picture, never text or markup) with <host>/app on its own line and the code in 64px (data-panel-pair-code), three steps; once connected a read-only card (orderLine + who made the last change); content max 768px. /kiosk (KioskApp): matchMedia orientation landscape renders the panel beside the unchanged portrait canvas (canvas keeps its tree position, so no remount); portrait unchanged and has no panel in the DOM; reissue clears phoneConnectedAt so the panel shows the new QR/code at once. /demo: D1 [Use my phone instead] (secondary, beside [Start]); useDemoSession.start(pairPhone) keeps deviceToken optional + pairCode, pings with the kiosk token in that mode, setClaimUrl for reissue; DemoApp own-phone mode: kiosk left (with pairCode and [Connect another phone]), PairingPanel instead of AssistantPanel (end card when paid/expired/learned review, else [Back to the start]), no ActionStrip, no touch-vs-talk card (counts happen on the other phone); ScenarioGuide send optional: sentences as text (data-scenario-say), no Play it for me, choosing a scenario keeps the current order (no re-scan), own lead/hint copy (phone.ts scenariosLeadOwnPhone, scenarioOwnPhoneHint); [Try again] makes a fresh pairable session. Tests: e2e/kiosk-pairing.spec.ts (192.0.2.44: landscape panel QR >= 320px, no token in panel text/markup, connected + order line, reissue replaces QR and code, portrait has no panel, own-phone demo claim -> scenario text -> pay on kiosk -> Try again fresh code); e2e/qa/pairing.qa.spec.ts (192.0.2.45, profile PAIRING minFont 18) kiosk 1440x900 and 1920x1080 waiting/connected, demo own-phone 1440x900 waiting/connected: 0 H, 0 T. Deviation: no 'listening' in the panel, the public session has no voice state (I-170). Docs: ARCHITECTURE (Pages, POST /api/session body), SECURITY, UX (C1a, K1, D1, D2), UI_GUIDE (pairing panel), UI_QA, ISSUE I-170. lint, build, test 851 passed/1 skipped, test:e2e 27 passed/14 @live skipped (rewritten evidence restored, I-099), qa:ui 33/33.

steps.name: two-device-e2e
steps.summary: e2e/two-device.spec.ts (kiosk 192.0.2.47, phone 192.0.2.46): browser A /kiosk at 1440x900 (pairing panel) and browser B, its own Chromium (390x844, mobile) whose fake camera plays a Y4M of the real claim URL (e2e/qrVideo.ts); B opens /app, taps [Scan a kiosk], [Turn on the camera], lands on /assistant claimed; A's panel shows 'Phone connected at'; B taps Start, Type instead, Eat here; an AI addToCart through the API with B's device token rings the kiosk tile and the panel says 1 item and 'by the AI'; AI requestCheckout opens the review; B taps [Yes, pay now]; A taps 카드, 카드 넣기; B shows the order number, the panel 'Paid'. No server or stream mocks. @live variant: B's fake mic plays hero-ko.wav, B reopens /assistant?s=..&e2e=1 (token stored), [Turn on the microphone], Eat here, waits for the hero cart and the kiosk's two lines. Real bug found and fixed (I-171, P1): [Scan a kiosk] on /app was a Next <Link>, so the client-side navigation kept /app's camera=() header and the scanner always said 'The camera isn't available.'; now a plain <a> (full load gets camera=(self)); the new test failed before the fix. Live result (npm run test:e2e:live, once, ~17:20 KST): 12 text @live passed; the two-device voice test and both voice.live hero orders failed at connect (connecting -> reconnecting -> error), because the Gemini API key still answers HTTP 402 (deep health keyGenerate fail, 'health keyGenerate: ApiError 402', all other checks ok), logged in I-104; re-run after a top-up. Docs: OPERATIONS 'Two-device demo' checklist (laptop full screen, scan/code, allow camera+mic, talk, pay on laptop, KakaoTalk/NAVER: open in Safari/Chrome or Order here by typing, reissue QR, voice needs key credits), README two-device steps, TESTING End to end. Evidence files rewritten by the runs restored by hand (I-099). lint, build, test 851 passed/1 skipped, test:e2e 28 passed/15 @live skipped.

steps.name: short-url
steps.summary: Optional runtime env SHORT_APP_URL (bare lowercase host, e.g. kibo-2026.web.app; anything with a scheme, port, path, capitals or a bad label is ignored with one console.warn per value) read per request by pairUrl(req) in src/lib/http.ts (tests first in http.test.ts): SHORT_APP_URL, else '<publicOrigin host>/app'. POST /api/session returns pairUrl next to every pairCode (route test: SHORT_APP_URL changes only pairUrl; claimUrl origin/path/query unchanged; demo sessions without a code get none). Client: CreatedSession.pairUrl; useKioskSession stores it (kept across reissueClaim, which does not change it); useDemoSession tokens.pairUrl; pairUrl prop threaded like pairCode through KioskApp/DemoApp -> KioskScreen -> Attract/Menu/Review/Payment/KioskToolbar/QrSheet -> PairCode (data-pair-url), and to PairingPanel (data-panel-pair-url); both fall back to the claim URL's host + /app for old stored sessions. QR images and claim URLs untouched. scripts/deploy.sh appends ,SHORT_APP_URL=<v> to --set-env-vars only when set in the deploying shell and refuses values with characters outside a-z0-9.- (deploy.test.ts: absent, passed through, injection refused). firebase.json (hosting public 'hosting-public/' with .gitkeep; redirects / -> <Cloud Run>/app and regex ^/(?P<path>.+)$ -> <Cloud Run>/:path, 302), not deployed; no Firebase SDK or client config added. playwright.qa.config.ts sets SHORT_APP_URL=kibo-2026.web.app on the QA server (E2E leaves it unset, so app-pair.spec still checks localhost:3100/app); kiosk.qa (K1, QR sheet) and pairing.qa (landscape panel) assert the short host on one line and the QR claim URL origin is the QA server; screenshots K1 1080x1920 and kiosk-pairing-waiting 1440x900 checked by eye. Docs: ARCHITECTURE (POST /api/session response, Pages, env table), OPERATIONS (deploy flag, 'Short address' section), UX A2, UI_GUIDE (kiosk pairing line, panel), UI_QA, ISSUE I-167 (code done; goes live with SHORT_APP_URL=kibo-2026.web.app sh scripts/deploy.sh). lint, build, test 857 passed/1 skipped, test:e2e 28 passed/15 @live skipped (rewritten evidence restored, I-099), qa:ui 33/33.
